children: Overview
France biomass energy firm's H1 revenue rose 43% yr/yr to €5.6 mln
Growth driven by new third-party project wins, including district heating and green gas initiatives
Confirmed orders up 20% yr/yr to €12 mln, increasing visibility for coming quarters
Outlook
Company says secured orders worth €12 mln provide increased visibility for coming quarters
Charwood Energy expects to announce additional projects in H2 2026
Result Drivers
THIRD-PARTY PROJECT WINS - Co said new projects for external clients, including district heating for Stellantis and green gas demonstration for GRDF, boosted activity
ORDER BOOK EXPANSION - Confirmed orders from third-party customers rose 20% yr/yr to €12 mln, increasing revenue visibility
PROPRIETARY PLANT DEVELOPMENT - Co said several power plants are under development, including a syngas facility for Verallia France
